proposals.note: The problem is graph connectivity on 6 nodes, which is invariant under any permutation of the nodes (S6 symmetry). The feature map encodes edges. To leverage this symmetry, the ansatz block must be equivariant or invariant under node relabeling. The proposed block uses a ring topology (CNOTs between i and i+1 mod 6) and uniform single-qubit rotations (RZ with shared parameters). This structure is invariant under cyclic permutations (Z6 subgroup of S6). While not fully S6 invariant, it captures the local connectivity structure better than arbitrary wires. The uniform RZ rotations ensure that the block treats all nodes identically, respecting the symmetry of the input features which are symmetric under node relabeling. The CNOT ring allows information to propagate around the cycle, capturing global connectivity patterns. Using only 2 parameters reduces overfitting risk and aligns with the low dev risk of previous simple structures.
